pasteBlockedSecureField.title: Not pasted into a password field
pasteBlockedSecureField.description: A secure text field had focus. The transcript is in History.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste
reliablePaste.description: Restore your clipboard only after the target app has read the transcript, and restore every item and format exactly. Turn off to use the legacy timed paste as a fallback. macOS and Windows only.

blockSecureFields.title: Never paste into password fields
blockSecureFields.description: When a secure text field has focus (or macOS Secure Input is on), skip the paste and show a notice instead. The transcript stays in History.

datasetLogging.title: Log dictations for training & analysis
datasetLogging.description: Keep every dictation's raw model output, cleaned text, LLM text, timings, pauses and frontmost app in the local dataset, with its audio. Export with `handy --export-dataset <dir>`. Nothing leaves this Mac.

verbatim.title: Verbatim transcription
verbatim.description: Prompt Whisper models with filler words so ums, uhs and false starts are kept in the raw transcript. Filler removal still cleans the pasted text. Whisper models only.

verbatimPrompt.title: Verbatim prompt
verbatimPrompt.description: Initial prompt given to Whisper in verbatim mode. Leave empty for the default.

llmTimeout.title: LLM timeout
llmTimeout.description: If the LLM (e.g. LM Studio) is unreachable or takes longer than this, the rule-cleaned text is pasted instead and a small notice is shown. Dictation never fails because the LLM is down.
